title: Public Statistics Data Platform and Open Data Portal
issuer: National Statistics Directorate, Republic of Valdemar
raw_text: The National Statistics Directorate, Republic of Valdemar, collects 1,400 statistical series across agriculture, transport, and demographics. Submission is by spreadsheet from 300 reporting units, then hand-validated, which takes nine days. We require a public statistics data platform on GCP with a BigQuery warehouse for validated series, Snowflake for the statistical model outputs, and a public open data portal over the de-identified subset. Validation must enforce a submission specification and reject non-conforming files with a specific error, not silently coerce them. A de-identification review must be documented and approved before any series is published. Every published series requires full lineage back to its submitting unit.
requirements: BigQuery warehouse for validated statistical series on GCP
Snowflake modelling of statistical outputs with full lineage to submitting unit
Submission specification enforcement rejecting non-conforming files with specific errors
Documented and approved de-identification review before publication
